model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the frequency distribution of various polarity scores. The horizontal x-axis, labeled "Polarity scores," utilizes a linear scale ranging from approximately -1.1 to 0.6, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2 and no specified units. The vertical y-axis, labeled "Counts," also employs a linear scale, extending from 0 to over 9000, with tick marks positioned at intervals of 2000. A single data series is depicted as a solid blue line with solid circular markers. The line begins at an x-value of roughly -1.1 with a count near 0, maintaining a steady, near-zero baseline until approximately x = -0.7. It then exhibits a minor rise to approximately 600 counts near x = -0.55, dips slightly, and subsequently begins a steep ascent. The line reaches its highest peak at exactly x = 0.0, corresponding to a maximum count of approximately 9200. Following this primary peak, the line sharply declines to about 3100 at x = 0.09 before rising to a secondary peak of roughly 5100 at x = 0.18. The data then follows a jagged downward trajectory, dropping to near 100 at x = 0.36, rising to a minor tertiary peak of about 1800 at x = 0.45, and ultimately concluding near a count of 0 at the final x-value of approximately 0.55.
